mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE drops > 0.5pp in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases consistently over 3 months but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a disinflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increase > 200k and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases consistently over 3 months but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive, it signals a strong supply-side economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 12-month MA and GDPC1 growth > 0% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
